summary: Free-form, multi-line ASCII DAT for scripts, GLSL shaders, notes, XML, configuration, and other text sources. It can edit text in-node or externally, load from disk or web paths, sync bidirectionally with files, and provide script-language/editor-extension metadata for consuming operators.

key_params.name: edit
key_params.note: Open an external text editor for this DAT.

key_params.name: file
key_params.note: Filesystem path and filename to load; accepts .txt and .dat files.

key_params.name: syncfile
key_params.note: Synchronize the DAT and file contents immediately and while either changes.

key_params.name: loadonstart
key_params.note: Reload the file from disk when the project starts.

key_params.name: write
key_params.note: Write DAT contents to disk when the .toe is saved.

key_params.name: language
key_params.note: Choose whether the DAT uses its input script language or its own node language.

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: File extension exposed to external editors.

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Word Wrap setting for node display.

common_gotchas: Text DAT stores text but does not execute it by itself; use the relevant Execute DAT or consuming GLSL/Python operator to run or compile the contents.
Sync to File loads the file immediately, creates a missing file on first DAT update, and keeps the file monitored so DAT and file edits update each other.
If the synced file is removed, the Text DAT retains its current contents rather than going blank.
Use http:// paths to load remote text, but use Web DAT when you need URL query/fetch workflow control.
Set Language and Edit/View Extension intentionally for shader or Python source so external editors and consuming operators interpret the text correctly.
